change.after: "traffic from policy-selected node-local backends destined to the policy's frontend is redirected back to the node-local backends (enabled by default)"

of.needed: whether socket-based load-balancing is enabled (the upgrade note names this mode but names no setting, cilium-config key, Helm value or flag that enables it)

consequence.statement: Traffic from policy-selected node-local backends destined to the policy's frontend is redirected back to the node-local backends (this behavior is enabled by default), so affected flows behave differently; the evidence states no failure.
consequence.remediation: Create local redirect policies with spec.skipRedirectFromBackend set to true to override this default redirect behavior.

assertion.statement: When Local Redirect Policy is used with socket-based load-balancing, traffic from policy-selected node-local backends destined to the policy's frontend is redirected back to the node-local backends, a behavior enabled by default in 1.16 that can be overridden by creating local redirect policies with skipRedirectFromBackend set to true.
